name: _lv_inv_area

provenance.source: Exact .139 LVGL lv_refr.c invalidate-area primitive: appends an lv_area_t to the display's invalidated-area list (disp+60.., count at disp+604) so _lv_display_refr_timer (0x0c38956c) repaints it on the next tick. Recovered from the firmware's own MiWearScreen wake handler (0x0c6d096c, 'invalidate screen.') and 40+ widget callers.

notes: Forced-repaint lever companion to lv_image_cache_drop: after the image cache is dropped the widget tree is unchanged, so nothing is marked dirty; passing an oversized area (clipped to the screen by lv_area_intersect 0x0c3a39b4) marks the whole active screen dirty so every on-screen image re-opens through the redirect on the next refresh instead of waiting for a navigation. Default display at *0x200bd200, active screen at disp+24; asserts if disp->rendering_in_progress (bit 1 of disp+58) is set, no-ops if lv_display_is_invalidation_enabled (disp+608) is 0. Must run on the UI owner thread, never under the interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
